a2a_jcs_v01_note: conformance-vectors/a2a-jcs-v01 is not present in a2aproject/a2a-tck at tag 1.0.0.alpha3 (nor on main). JCS/JWS AgentCard signing requirements CARD-SIGN-001..004 are defined in tck/requirements/agent_card.py (tagged NOT_AUTOMATABLE in 1.0.0.alpha3), and canonicalization/JWS examples are extracted from specification/specification.md § 8.4-8.5.

must_requirements.title: Agent Card must be available
must_requirements.description: A2A Servers MUST make an Agent Card available describing the server's identity, capabilities, skills, and interaction requirements.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Agent Card retrievable by clients

must_requirements.title: AgentCard must properly declare supported protocols
must_requirements.description: The AgentCard MUST properly declare supported protocols.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Supported protocols declared in AgentCard

must_requirements.title: Each interface must declare transport and URL
must_requirements.description: Each interface in supportedInterfaces MUST accurately declare its transport protocol and URL.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Each interface has accurate transport and URL

must_requirements.title: AgentCard contains required fields
must_requirements.description: An AgentCard MUST contain all required fields as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition including name, description, supportedInterfaces, capabilities, and skills.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: All required AgentCard fields present

must_requirements.title: Extended Agent Card requires authentication
must_requirements.description: The client MUST authenticate the GetExtendedAgentCard request using one of the schemes declared in the public AgentCard.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Authenticated request returns extended card

must_requirements.title: Extended card not configured returns specific error
must_requirements.description: If the agent declares support but has not configured an extended card, it MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError returned

must_requirements.title: Agent Card canonicalized with JCS before signing
must_requirements.description: Before signing, the Agent Card content MUST be canonicalized using the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as defined in RFC 8785.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Agent Card canonicalized per RFC 8785 before signing

must_requirements.title: Signatures field excluded from signed content
must_requirements.description: The signatures field itself MUST be excluded from the content being signed to avoid circular dependencies.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Signatures field excluded from signing payload

must_requirements.title: Signature protected header includes required parameters
must_requirements.description: The JWS protected header MUST include alg (algorithm) and kid (key ID) parameters.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Protected header contains alg and kid

must_requirements.title: Expired or revoked keys must not be used for verification
must_requirements.description: Expired or revoked keys MUST NOT be used for signature verification.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Expired/revoked keys rejected during verification

must_requirements.title: Production deployments must use encrypted communication
must_requirements.description: Production deployments MUST use encrypted communication (HTTPS for HTTP-based bindings, TLS for gRPC).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: All production traffic encrypted via TLS

must_requirements.title: Server must authenticate every incoming request
must_requirements.description: The A2A Server MUST authenticate every incoming request based on the provided credentials and its declared authentication requirements.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Every request authenticated

must_requirements.title: Agent MUST use a Task to track operation requiring authorization
must_requirements.description: To request that a client fulfills an authorization request, the agent MUST use a Task to track the operation it is performing.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Task used to track authorization-requiring operation

must_requirements.title: Agent MUST transition to auth_required state
must_requirements.description: To request that a client fulfills an authorization request, the agent MUST transition the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Task transitions to auth_required for authorization

must_requirements.title: Agent MUST include status message explaining authorization
must_requirements.description: The agent MUST include a TaskStatus message explaining the required authorization, unless the details have been negotiated out-of-band or via an extension.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskStatus message explains required authorization

must_requirements.title: Agent MUST arrange to receive credentials out-of-band
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST arrange to receive credentials via an out-of-band means, unless an in-band mechanism has been negotiated out-of-band or via an extension.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Credentials received out-of-band

must_requirements.title: Authorization checks on every operation request
must_requirements.description: Servers MUST implement authorization checks on every A2A Protocol Operations request.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Authorization verified for every request

must_requirements.title: Results scoped to caller's authorization boundaries
must_requirements.description: Implementations MUST scope results to the caller's authorized access boundaries as defined by the agent's authorization model.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Results limited to authorized scope

must_requirements.title: Server must not reveal existence of unauthorized resources
must_requirements.description: Servers MUST NOT reveal the existence of resources the client is not authorized to access.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Unauthorized resources invisible to client

must_requirements.title: Implement A2AService gRPC service
must_requirements.description: gRPC binding implementations MUST implement the A2AService gRPC service as defined in the normative a2a.proto file.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: A2AService gRPC service fully implemented

must_requirements.title: Use Protocol Buffers version 3 serialization
must_requirements.description: gRPC binding MUST use Protocol Buffers version 3 for serialization.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Proto3 serialization used

must_requirements.title: gRPC over HTTP/2 with TLS
must_requirements.description: gRPC binding MUST use gRPC over HTTP/2 with TLS.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Communication over HTTP/2 with TLS

must_requirements.title: Service parameters transmitted as gRPC metadata
must_requirements.description: A2A service parameters MUST be transmitted using gRPC metadata (headers). Service parameter names MUST be transmitted as gRPC metadata keys.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: A2A-Version and A2A-Extensions sent as gRPC metadata

must_requirements.title: A2A errors include ErrorInfo in status details
must_requirements.description: For A2A-specific errors, implementations MUST include a google.rpc.ErrorInfo message in the status.details array with reason (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE without Error suffix) and domain set to 'a2a-protocol.org'.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: ErrorInfo with reason and domain in status details

must_requirements.title: A2A error types mapped to correct gRPC status codes
must_requirements.description: All A2A-specific error types MUST be mapped to their specified gRPC status codes: TaskNotFoundError=NOT_FOUND, TaskNotCancelableError=FAILED_PRECONDITION, PushNotificationNotSupportedError=UNIMPLEMENTED, UnsupportedOperationError=UNIMPLEMENTED, ContentTypeNotSupportedError=INVALID_ARGUMENT, InvalidAgentResponseError=INTERNAL, ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError=FAILED_PRECONDITION, ExtensionSupportRequiredError=FAILED_PRECONDITION, VersionNotSupportedError=UNIMPLEMENTED.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Each A2A error mapped to correct gRPC status

must_requirements.title: gRPC streaming uses server streaming RPCs
must_requirements.description: gRPC streaming MUST use server streaming RPCs for real-time updates with StreamResponse messages.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Server streaming RPC delivers StreamResponse messages

must_requirements.title: RESTful resource-based URL patterns
must_requirements.description: HTTP+JSON/REST binding MUST use the specified RESTful resource-based URL patterns for all operations.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Correct URL patterns used for each operation

must_requirements.title: Standard HTTP methods for each operation
must_requirements.description: HTTP+JSON/REST binding MUST use standard HTTP verbs: GET for retrieval, POST for creation/actions, DELETE for removal.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Correct HTTP methods used per operation

must_requirements.title: Content-Type is application/json
must_requirements.description: HTTP+JSON/REST binding MUST use Content-Type application/json for requests and responses.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Content-Type header is application/json

must_requirements.title: Service parameters transmitted as HTTP headers
must_requirements.description: A2A service parameters MUST be transmitted using standard HTTP request headers for the REST binding.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: A2A-Version and A2A-Extensions sent as HTTP headers

must_requirements.title: Query parameter names use camelCase
must_requirements.description: Query parameter names MUST use camelCase to match the JSON serialization of Protocol Buffer field names.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Query params like contextId, pageSize, pageToken

must_requirements.title: Error responses use AIP-193 format
must_requirements.description: HTTP error responses MUST use the AIP-193 representation with Content-Type application/json containing an error object with code, status, message, and details fields.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error responses conform to AIP-193 structure

must_requirements.title: A2A errors include ErrorInfo in details array
must_requirements.description: For A2A-specific errors, implementations MUST include a google.rpc.ErrorInfo message in the details array with reason (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE), domain (a2a-protocol.org), and optional metadata.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error details array contains ErrorInfo with correct reason and domain

must_requirements.title: A2A errors map to correct HTTP status codes
must_requirements.description: Each A2A error type MUST map to the HTTP status code specified in the error code mappings table (e.g., TaskNotFoundError to 404, ContentTypeNotSupportedError to 415).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: HTTP status code matches the spec-defined mapping for each error

must_requirements.title: REST streaming uses Server-Sent Events
must_requirements.description: REST streaming MUST use Server-Sent Events with the data field containing JSON serializations of StreamResponse objects.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: SSE stream with StreamResponse JSON in data field

must_requirements.title: Requests use JSON-RPC 2.0 format
must_requirements.description: All JSON-RPC requests MUST follow the standard JSON-RPC 2.0 format with jsonrpc, id, method, and params fields.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Requests conform to JSON-RPC 2.0 structure

must_requirements.title: Content-Type is application/json
must_requirements.description: JSON-RPC requests and responses MUST use Content-Type application/json.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Content-Type header is application/json

must_requirements.title: Method names use PascalCase matching gRPC conventions
must_requirements.description: JSON-RPC method names MUST use PascalCase matching gRPC conventions (e.g., SendMessage, GetTask).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Methods named in PascalCase

must_requirements.title: Service parameters transmitted as HTTP headers
must_requirements.description: A2A service parameters MUST be transmitted using standard HTTP request headers for JSON-RPC binding.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: A2A-Version and A2A-Extensions sent as HTTP headers

must_requirements.title: Error responses use JSON-RPC 2.0 error object structure
must_requirements.description: JSON-RPC error responses MUST use the standard JSON-RPC 2.0 error object structure with code, message, and optional data. The data field, when present, MUST be an array containing google.protobuf.Any messages in ProtoJSON representation.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Errors include numeric code, message, and data array

must_requirements.title: A2A-specific errors use codes -32001 to -32099
must_requirements.description: A2A-specific errors MUST use error codes in the range -32001 to -32099 as defined in the error code mappings.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: A2A error codes within specified range

must_requirements.title: A2A errors include ErrorInfo in data array
must_requirements.description: For A2A-specific errors, implementations MUST include a google.rpc.ErrorInfo message in the data array with reason (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE), domain (a2a-protocol.org), and optional metadata.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error data array contains ErrorInfo with correct reason and domain

must_requirements.title: Streaming uses Server-Sent Events with text/event-stream
must_requirements.description: JSON-RPC streaming responses MUST use Server-Sent Events with Content-Type text/event-stream. Each SSE data line contains a JSON-RPC response wrapping a StreamResponse object.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: SSE stream with JSON-RPC wrapped StreamResponse events

must_requirements.title: A2A error types mapped to correct JSON-RPC error codes
must_requirements.description: All A2A-specific error types MUST be mapped to their specified JSON-RPC error codes: TaskNotFoundError=-32001, TaskNotCancelableError=-32002, PushNotificationNotSupportedError=-32003, UnsupportedOperationError=-32004, ContentTypeNotSupportedError=-32005, InvalidAgentResponseError=-32006, ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError=-32007, ExtensionSupportRequiredError=-32008, VersionNotSupportedError=-32009.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Each A2A error mapped to correct numeric code

must_requirements.title: SendMessage returns Task or Message
must_requirements.description: The SendMessage operation MUST return immediately with either task information or a response message.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Response contains either a Task object or a Message object

must_requirements.title: SendMessage rejects messages to terminal tasks
must_requirements.description: Messages sent to Tasks that are in a terminal state (completed, canceled, rejected) MUST return UnsupportedOperationError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: UnsupportedOperationError returned for terminal task

must_requirements.title: SendMessage returns ContentTypeNotSupportedError for unsupported media
must_requirements.description: A Media Type provided in the request's message parts that is not supported by the agent MUST result in ContentTypeNotSupportedError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: ContentTypeNotSupportedError returned

must_requirements.title: SendStreamingMessage establishes streaming connection
must_requirements.description: The SendStreamingMessage operation MUST establish a streaming connection for real-time updates.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Streaming connection established with real-time events

must_requirements.title: Message-only stream contains exactly one Message then closes
must_requirements.description: If the agent returns a Message, the stream MUST contain exactly one Message object and then close immediately.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Stream contains single Message then closes

must_requirements.title: Task lifecycle stream begins with Task and closes at terminal state
must_requirements.description: If the agent returns a Task, the stream MUST begin with the Task object, followed by zero or more update events. The stream MUST close when the task reaches a terminal state.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Stream starts with Task, followed by events, closes at terminal state

must_requirements.title: GetTask returns current task state
must_requirements.description: GetTask retrieves the current state of a previously initiated task including status, artifacts, and optionally history.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Current task state returned with status and artifacts

must_requirements.title: GetTask returns TaskNotFoundError for invalid task ID
must_requirements.description: GetTask MUST return TaskNotFoundError when the task ID does not exist or is not accessible.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskNotFoundError returned

must_requirements.title: ListTasks returns only authorized tasks
must_requirements.description: The ListTasks operation MUST return only tasks visible to the authenticated client.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Only authorized tasks returned

must_requirements.title: ListTasks uses cursor-based pagination
must_requirements.description: ListTasks MUST use cursor-based pagination via pageToken/nextPageToken.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Cursor-based pagination with pageToken/nextPageToken

must_requirements.title: ListTasks sorts by status timestamp descending
must_requirements.description: Implementations MUST return tasks sorted by their status timestamp in descending order (most recently updated first).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Tasks sorted by status timestamp descending

must_requirements.title: ListTasks nextPageToken empty string on final page
must_requirements.description: The nextPageToken field MUST always be present in the response. When there are no more results, it MUST be set to an empty string.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: nextPageToken is empty string on final page

must_requirements.title: ListTasks omits artifacts when includeArtifacts is false
must_requirements.description: When includeArtifacts is false (the default), the artifacts field MUST be omitted entirely from each Task object in the response.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Artifacts field omitted entirely when includeArtifacts=false

must_requirements.title: CancelTask returns updated task with cancellation status
must_requirements.description: The CancelTask operation attempts to cancel the specified task and returns its updated state.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Updated Task with cancellation status returned

must_requirements.title: CancelTask returns TaskNotCancelableError for terminal tasks
must_requirements.description: CancelTask MUST return TaskNotCancelableError when the task is not in a cancelable state (already completed, failed, or canceled).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskNotCancelableError returned

must_requirements.title: CancelTask returns TaskNotFoundError for invalid task ID
must_requirements.description: CancelTask MUST return TaskNotFoundError when the task ID does not exist or is not accessible.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskNotFoundError returned

must_requirements.title: Blocking mode waits for terminal or interrupted state
must_requirements.description: When return_immediately is false or unset, the operation MUST wait until the task reaches a terminal state (completed, failed, canceled, rejected) or an interrupted state (input_required, auth_required) before returning. This is the default behavior.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Response delayed until terminal or interrupted state

must_requirements.title: Non-blocking mode returns immediately
must_requirements.description: When return_immediately is true, the operation MUST return immediately after creating the task, even if processing is still in progress.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Response returned immediately with in-progress state

must_requirements.title: Server returns appropriate errors with actionable information
must_requirements.description: Servers MUST return appropriate errors and SHOULD provide actionable information to help clients resolve issues.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error responses include code, message, and optional details

must_requirements.title: Server validates all input parameters before processing
must_requirements.description: Servers MUST validate all input parameters before processing.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Invalid parameters rejected with validation error

must_requirements.title: Push notification operations return error when not supported
must_requirements.description: If AgentCard.capabilities.pushNotifications is false or not present, push notification operations MUST return PushNotificationNotSupportedError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: PushNotificationNotSupportedError returned

must_requirements.title: Streaming operations return error when not supported
must_requirements.description: If AgentCard.capabilities.streaming is false or not present, SendStreamingMessage and SubscribeToTask MUST return UnsupportedOperationError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: UnsupportedOperationError returned

must_requirements.title: Extended agent card operations return error when not supported
must_requirements.description: If AgentCard.capabilities.extendedAgentCard is false or not present, GetExtendedAgentCard MUST return UnsupportedOperationError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: UnsupportedOperationError returned

must_requirements.title: Required extension missing returns ExtensionSupportRequiredError
must_requirements.description: When a client requests use of an extension marked as required=true but the client does not declare support, the agent MUST return ExtensionSupportRequiredError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: ExtensionSupportRequiredError returned

must_requirements.title: Generated contextId must be included in response
must_requirements.description: If an agent generates a new contextId, it MUST be included in the response (either Task or Message).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Generated contextId present in response

must_requirements.title: Agent rejects unacceptable client-provided contextId
must_requirements.description: If an agent cannot accept a client-provided contextId, it MUST reject the request with an error and MUST NOT generate a new contextId for the response.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error returned when client contextId not accepted

must_requirements.title: Agent generates unique taskId for new tasks
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST generate a unique taskId for each new task they create. The generated taskId MUST be included in the Task object.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Task contains server-generated unique taskId

must_requirements.title: Agent returns TaskNotFoundError for invalid taskId in message
must_requirements.description: When a client includes a taskId in a Message that does not correspond to an existing task, agents MUST return TaskNotFoundError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskNotFoundError returned

must_requirements.title: Agent infers contextId from task when only taskId provided
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST infer contextId from the task if only taskId is provided.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: contextId inferred from referenced task

must_requirements.title: Agent rejects mismatching contextId and taskId
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST reject messages containing mismatching contextId and taskId (i.e., the provided contextId is different from that of the referenced Task).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error returned for mismatching contextId/taskId

must_requirements.title: History length does not exceed requested historyLength
must_requirements.description: The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided historyLength value.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: History message count is at most historyLength

must_requirements.title: Task object contains required fields
must_requirements.description: A Task object MUST contain required fields: id and status as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Task objects include all required fields

must_requirements.title: TaskState uses valid enumeration values
must_requirements.description: TaskState values MUST be one of the defined enumeration values: submitted, working, input_required, auth_required, completed, failed, canceled, rejected.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Only valid TaskState enum values used

must_requirements.title: Message contains required fields
must_requirements.description: A Message object MUST contain required fields: role, parts, and messageId as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Message objects include all required fields

must_requirements.title: Role uses valid enumeration values
must_requirements.description: Role values MUST be one of the defined values: user or agent.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Only valid Role enum values used

must_requirements.title: Part uses oneof semantics
must_requirements.description: A Part object MUST contain exactly one of: text, file (raw bytes or URL reference), or data (structured JSON).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Part contains exactly one content type

must_requirements.title: Artifact contains required fields
must_requirements.description: An Artifact object MUST contain required fields: artifactId and parts as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Artifact objects include all required fields

must_requirements.title: TaskStatus contains required state field
must_requirements.description: A TaskStatus object MUST contain the state field with a valid TaskState value.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskStatus includes state field

must_requirements.title: JSON serialization uses camelCase field names
must_requirements.description: All JSON serializations of the A2A protocol data model MUST use camelCase naming for field names, not snake_case.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: All JSON field names use camelCase

must_requirements.title: Enum values use ProtoJSON string representation
must_requirements.description: Enum values MUST be represented according to the ProtoJSON specification as their string names as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition (typically SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Enum values serialized as proto string names

must_requirements.title: Timestamps use ISO 8601 format in UTC
must_requirements.description: Timestamps MUST be represented as ISO 8601 formatted strings in UTC timezone. Timestamps MUST NOT include timezone offsets other than 'Z'.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Timestamps formatted as ISO 8601 with Z suffix

must_requirements.title: Required fields must be present in messages
must_requirements.description: Fields marked with REQUIRED field_behavior annotation MUST be present and set in valid messages. Arrays marked as required MUST contain at least one element.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Required fields present and set

must_requirements.title: All supported protocols provide identical functionality
must_requirements.description: When an agent supports multiple protocols, all supported protocols MUST provide the same set of operations and capabilities.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Same operations available across all bindings

must_requirements.title: All bindings return semantically equivalent results
must_requirements.description: All supported protocols MUST return semantically equivalent results for the same requests.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Same request produces equivalent results across bindings

must_requirements.title: All bindings map errors consistently
must_requirements.description: All supported protocols MUST map errors consistently using appropriate protocol-specific codes.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Errors mapped consistently across bindings

must_requirements.title: All bindings support same authentication schemes
must_requirements.description: All supported protocols MUST support the same authentication schemes declared in the AgentCard.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Same auth schemes across all bindings

must_requirements.title: Agents must declare all supported protocols in AgentCard
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST declare all supported protocols in their AgentCard.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: All supported protocols listed in AgentCard

must_requirements.title: CreatePushNotificationConfig establishes webhook endpoint
must_requirements.description: The CreatePushNotificationConfig operation MUST establish a webhook endpoint for task update notifications.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Webhook endpoint created and config returned with ID

must_requirements.title: Push config persists until task completion or deletion
must_requirements.description: The push notification configuration MUST persist until task completion or explicit deletion.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Config persists across multiple task updates

must_requirements.title: GetPushNotificationConfig returns configuration details
must_requirements.description: The GetPushNotificationConfig operation MUST return configuration details including webhook URL and notification settings.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Full configuration details returned

must_requirements.title: GetPushNotificationConfig fails for nonexistent config
must_requirements.description: The GetPushNotificationConfig operation MUST fail if the configuration does not exist or the client lacks access.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Error returned for nonexistent config

must_requirements.title: ListPushNotificationConfigs returns all active configs
must_requirements.description: The ListPushNotificationConfig operation MUST return all active push notification configurations for the specified task.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: All active configs returned for task

must_requirements.title: DeletePushNotificationConfig permanently removes config
must_requirements.description: The DeletePushNotificationConfig operation MUST permanently remove the specified push notification configuration.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Config permanently removed, no further notifications

must_requirements.title: DeletePushNotificationConfig is idempotent
must_requirements.description: The DeletePushNotificationConfig operation MUST be idempotent - multiple deletions of the same config have the same effect.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Repeated deletions succeed without error

must_requirements.title: Agent includes authentication in webhook requests
must_requirements.description: The agent MUST include authentication credentials in the webhook request headers as specified in the PushNotificationConfig.authentication field.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Webhook requests include configured auth credentials

must_requirements.title: Agent attempts delivery at least once per webhook
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST attempt delivery at least once for each configured webhook.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: At-least-once delivery attempted

must_requirements.title: Webhook payload uses StreamResponse format
must_requirements.description: The webhook payload MUST use the StreamResponse format containing exactly one of: task, message, statusUpdate, or artifactUpdate.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Payload is valid StreamResponse with single field

must_requirements.title: Events delivered in generation order
must_requirements.description: All implementations MUST deliver events in the order they were generated. Events MUST NOT be reordered during transmission.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Events arrive in generation order

must_requirements.title: Events broadcast to all active streams
must_requirements.description: When multiple streams are active for a task, events MUST be broadcast to all active streams for that task.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: All active streams receive the same events

must_requirements.title: Each stream receives same events in same order
must_requirements.description: Each stream MUST receive the same events in the same order.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Event ordering consistent across all streams

must_requirements.title: Closing one stream does not affect others
must_requirements.description: Closing one stream MUST NOT affect other active streams for the same task.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Other streams continue when one closes

must_requirements.title: SubscribeToTask returns Task as first event
must_requirements.description: The SubscribeToTask operation MUST return a Task object as the first event in the stream, representing the current state of the task at the time of subscription.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: First event is a Task object with current state

must_requirements.title: SubscribeToTask stream terminates at terminal state
must_requirements.description: The SubscribeToTask stream MUST terminate when the task reaches a terminal state (completed, failed, canceled, or rejected).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Stream closes at terminal state

must_requirements.title: SubscribeToTask rejects terminal tasks
must_requirements.description: SubscribeToTask MUST return UnsupportedOperationError when attempted on a task that is in a terminal state.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: UnsupportedOperationError returned for terminal task

must_requirements.title: SubscribeToTask returns TaskNotFoundError for invalid task
must_requirements.description: SubscribeToTask MUST return TaskNotFoundError when the task ID does not exist or is not accessible.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: TaskNotFoundError returned

must_requirements.title: Clients must send A2A-Version header with each request
must_requirements.description: Clients MUST send the A2A-Version header with each request to maintain compatibility after an agent upgrades.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: A2A-Version header present in every request

must_requirements.title: Agent processes requests using requested version semantics
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST process requests using the semantics of the requested A2A-Version (matching Major.Minor).
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Request processed per requested version

must_requirements.title: Agent returns VersionNotSupportedError for unsupported version
must_requirements.description: If the version is not supported by the interface, agents MUST return a VersionNotSupportedError.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: VersionNotSupportedError returned

must_requirements.title: Agent interprets empty version header as 0.3
must_requirements.description: Agents MUST interpret an empty A2A-Version value as version 0.3.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Empty version treated as 0.3

must_requirements.title: Patch version numbers must not affect negotiation
must_requirements.description: Patch version numbers MUST NOT be considered when clients and servers negotiate protocol versions. Patch version numbers SHOULD NOT be used in requests, responses and Agent Cards.
must_requirements.expected_behavior: Patch versions ignored in negotiation

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Agent Card must be available
agent_card_all_requirements.description: A2A Servers MUST make an Agent Card available describing the server's identity, capabilities, skills, and interaction requirements.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: AgentCard must properly declare supported protocols
agent_card_all_requirements.description: The AgentCard MUST properly declare supported protocols.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Each interface must declare transport and URL
agent_card_all_requirements.description: Each interface in supportedInterfaces MUST accurately declare its transport protocol and URL.
agent_card_all_requirements.expected_behavior: Each interface has accurate transport and URL

agent_card_all_requirements.title: AgentCard contains required fields
agent_card_all_requirements.description: An AgentCard MUST contain all required fields as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition including name, description, supportedInterfaces, capabilities, and skills.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Extended Agent Card requires authentication
agent_card_all_requirements.description: The client MUST authenticate the GetExtendedAgentCard request using one of the schemes declared in the public AgentCard.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Extended card not configured returns specific error
agent_card_all_requirements.description: If the agent declares support but has not configured an extended card, it MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Agent Card canonicalized with JCS before signing
agent_card_all_requirements.description: Before signing, the Agent Card content MUST be canonicalized using the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as defined in RFC 8785.
agent_card_all_requirements.expected_behavior: Agent Card canonicalized per RFC 8785 before signing

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Signatures field excluded from signed content
agent_card_all_requirements.description: The signatures field itself MUST be excluded from the content being signed to avoid circular dependencies.
agent_card_all_requirements.expected_behavior: Signatures field excluded from signing payload

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Signature protected header includes required parameters
agent_card_all_requirements.description: The JWS protected header MUST include alg (algorithm) and kid (key ID) parameters.
agent_card_all_requirements.expected_behavior: Protected header contains alg and kid

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Expired or revoked keys must not be used for verification
agent_card_all_requirements.description: Expired or revoked keys MUST NOT be used for signature verification.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Agent Card endpoint includes Cache-Control header
agent_card_all_requirements.description: Agent Card HTTP endpoints SHOULD include a Cache-Control response header with a max-age directive appropriate for the agent's expected update frequency.
agent_card_all_requirements.expected_behavior: Cache-Control header with max-age present in response

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Agent Card endpoint includes ETag header
agent_card_all_requirements.description: Agent Card HTTP endpoints SHOULD include an ETag response header derived from the Agent Card's version field or a hash of the card content.

agent_card_all_requirements.title: Agent Card endpoint may include Last-Modified header
agent_card_all_requirements.description: Agent Card HTTP endpoints MAY include a Last-Modified response header.
